name: hero
title: Hero
description: The opening section of a website page: a big headline, a sentence and what to do next, over a moving decoration in the brand's colours. Dark by default. Styles: aurora, orbit.

examples.name: hero-demo
examples.title: Hero
examples.description: Eyebrow, a two-tone headline, a sentence and two buttons. Dark with glowing lights, even on a light page.

examples.name: hero-orbit
examples.title: Orbit
examples.description: variant="orbit": the copy on the start side; rings of the brand colour ripple out around the actions, which become a white pill.

examples.name: hero-search
examples.title: With a search
examples.description: actions takes anything: here a search field and its button.

examples.name: hero-inherit
examples.title: Follow the page
examples.description: scheme="inherit" uses the page's light or dark scheme instead of always being dark.

props.name: titleSecondary
props.description: A second headline line in the muted text colour.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences under the headline.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A small line above the headline, such as an Eyebrow or a "what's new" Badge and Link.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons, a search field or chips. At most two buttons reads best.

props.name: variant
props.description: aurora: soft lights drift behind centred text. orbit: text on the start side, rings of the brand colour around the actions on the far side. gallery and cards follow (RFC-003).

props.name: scheme
props.description: dark: always the brand's dark colours, so the lights glow, even on a light page. inherit: follow the page.

props.name: theme
props.description: The tenant id, so a dark hero renders dark on the server. Otherwise it's copied from the nearest themed ancestor.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Level of the headline. Use 2 or lower for a hero inside a longer page.

props.name: pauseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the pause toggle.

keyboard.action: On the pause toggle, pauses or resumes the lights.

notes: A section named by its headline (aria-labelledby).
WCAG 2.2.2: the lights loop slowly, so a pause toggle with a fixed name and aria-pressed is always shown. With reduced motion, nothing moves and the toggle is removed.
The decoration is aria-hidden. In the default dark scheme, text and buttons use the brand's dark roles, whose contrast the engine proves.
Two headline lines are read with a space between them.
orbit: the rings and stars are aria-hidden; the actions follow the copy in reading order. Buttons at the centre are a white pill: the scheme's lightest text-safe pair (16.8:1 measured on Vela).

do: Use one Hero per page, at the top.
Keep the headline to two short lines.
dont: Don't put more than two buttons in actions.
Don't place text over the lights outside the Hero's own copy.
